text: dsh-ctx-visualizer 是面向 DSH Web 会话的上下文观察插件。在会话界面中加入“上下文透视”面板，捕获模型请求、响应和工具执行，并按轮次与步骤展示时间线、请求上下文、架构视图及原始记录。它还可从会话日志补录启用前的步骤，并将捕获内容保存在本机，方便调试 Agent 循环和比较上下文变化。适合需要检查模型实际输入与工具结果的 DSH 用户；不需要额外账号或密钥。

dsh-ctx-visualizer adds a Context Lens panel to DSH Web. It captures model requests, responses, and tool runs, displaying turns with context and response views. It can backfill earlier steps from session logs and save captures locally, helping users inspect model inputs and agent loops.
我想看每次发给模型的 system prompt 和对话上下文。
能不能按步骤查看模型调用、工具执行和结果回填的时间线？
我想比较同一轮里每次请求新增了哪些消息和工具结果。
怎样从会话日志补回插件启用前的模型调用记录？
I need to inspect the exact context sent with each model request in a DSH session.
How can I review tool calls, results, and follow-up model requests as a timeline?
想把模型请求和响应的原始 JSON 打开查看或复制。
Can I restore earlier context steps from the session log after enabling the plugin?
dsh-ctx-visualizer 的功能「模型请求捕获」：监听模型流并记录请求消息、系统内容、工具定义和流式响应，按会话步骤保存。
dsh-ctx-visualizer 的功能「工具执行关联」：将工具调用参数、结果、耗时与错误状态关联回产生该调用的模型步骤。
dsh-ctx-visualizer 的功能「上下文时间线」：在会话面板按轮次和步骤浏览调用，查看请求上下文、模型响应、工具运行和原始记录。
dsh-ctx-visualizer 的功能「历史补录与本机保存」：可从会话日志重建启用前的步骤，并在启用持久化时恢复此前捕获。
dsh-ctx-visualizer 默认把捕获内容写入本机目录；记录可能含完整上下文，代码只对特定常见密钥前缀脱敏。

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · dsh-ctx-visualizer：English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> See exactly what context [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) assembles for every model call — system vs user content, tool schemas, parsed tool calls, tool executions and the follow-up calls — as a per-turn timeline and a dynamic architecture view.

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · dsh-ctx-visualizer：A community plugin for DeepSeek Harness (tagged `dsh-plugin`), not an official package. It is for anyone who wants to study the agent loop in detail: inside one multi-turn exchange — *call the model → parse tool calls → execute tools → feed results back → call the model again* — what exactly was sent to the model at each step, what was added compared with the previous step, and which part is growing.

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · Features：- **Left · turns**: one card per turn (user question, call count, tool-run count, context tokens, elapsed time, most-used tools). The column is a fixed-height window you can scroll to reach earlier turns.
- **Top · horizontal timeline**: every step inside the selected turn — `Step 1 · model call → runs bash / results fed back → Step 2 …`. Click any node to switch.
- **Right · detail** for the selected step:
  - **Architecture** (default): generated dynamically from the actual content — the system prompt is split into sections by its own headings, tools are grouped by origin (MCP server / built-in), and the conversation history is drawn as `user → model call → tool result` chains per user input, with messages new to this step highlighted and compaction summaries called out. On the right, this step's flow: request → model → each tool call's outcome/duration/result size → fed back into the next request.
  - **Request context**: shows only the messages *new in this step* by default; system content and the tool list collapse automatically when unchanged; a stacked bar of the context composition (system / user input / tool results / plugin injections

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · Compatibility：| Item | Version |
| --- | --- |
| Developed and verified on | DeepSeek Harness Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` `0.2.2-rc.1` (Web GUI) |
| Node.js (to run the tests) | ≥ 20 |

DeepSeek Harness is still in Developer Preview, so the events and interfaces this plugin relies on may change incompatibly. If something breaks, check the version first and [open an issue](https://github.com/cenbonew/dsh-ctx-visualizer/issues).

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · Install：The plugin has no npm dependencies, so cloning is enough:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/cenbonew/dsh-ctx-visualizer.git
```

Then install that local bundle in DeepSeek Harness, either way:

- **Ask the agent**: say “install the local bundle at `/absolute/path/dsh-ctx-visualizer` with the Plugin Manager”.
- **Settings page**: Settings › Plugins (if your build supports installing a bundle from a local path).

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · Install：`dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json` is what makes it installable as a bundle; the frontend half is declared by `dsh.client` and joins the Web GUI automatically.

After installing, **refresh the page** and switch to “Context Lens” at the top of any conversation. Model calls made after the plugin was enabled are captured live; earlier steps are backfilled from the session log automatically.
dsh-ctx-visualizer README · Install：To update: `git pull`, then toggle the bundle off and on in the Plugin Manager (or restart Harness) and refresh the page.
dsh-ctx-visualizer README · How it works：Read-only observation built on first-class Harness events; the agent loop is never modified:

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · How it works：| Event / service | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `llm/stream` (waterfall) | Receives the full `GenerateOptions` of every model request (`messages`, `tools`, model, …) and collects text, reasoning, tool calls and usage while passing the response stream through unchanged |
| `agent/request` | Associates turn / step numbers |
| `tools/execute`, `tools/result` | Tool arguments, results, duration and outcome, correlated back to their step by `callId` |
| `agent/error` | Records failed steps |
| `sessionQuery.readSession` | Backfill: replays the `surfaceOp` (append / replace over a seq range) of `system/message`, `user/message`, `assistant/message` and `tool/result` to reconstruct the context each call received |

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · How it works：The frontend is a `conversation.view` slot plugin that reads the host-side `ctxVisualizer` service over typert Remote. An Inspect Provider named `CtxVisualizer` is also registered so an agent can query capture status with `cordis_inspect_query`.

Every listener is wrapped in try/catch, so a capture failure never affects the agent itself.
dsh-ctx-visualizer README · Configuration：There is no settings form yet. Pass config to the `ctx-visualizer` row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, or edit `DEFAULTS` at the top of `lib/index.js`:

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `capture` | `true` | Master switch |
| `persist` | `true` | Write captures to disk |
| `persistDir` | `~/.dsh/ctx-visualizer/captures` | Capture directory (0700, files 0600) |
| `backfill` | `true` | Rebuild earlier steps from the session log |
| `backfillIntervalMs` | `30000` | Minimum gap between two backfills of one session |
| `maxStepsPerSession` | `80` | Live steps kept per session (rebuilt steps do not count) |
| `maxSessions` | `40` | Sessions kept |
| `maxCharsPerText` / `maxCharsPerToolResult` | `400000` / `120000` | Truncation bound per stored text block |
| `redactSecrets` | `true` | Redact before storage |

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · Privacy and security：- Captures are the **full model context** and may contain code, file contents and business data returned by tools. Everything stays on this machine; nothing is uploaded.
- The default redaction only recognises well-known secret prefixes and **cannot** mask every sensitive value. Check before sharing a screenshot or a copied JSON block.
- Model replies and reasoning text are not redacted yet.
- “Clear captures” in the toolbar also deletes the files on disk.

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · Limitations：- Auxiliary calls such as session-title generation and context compaction are not part of the session log, so they cannot be backfilled (tick “Show aux calls” to see them when captured live).
- File attachments are projected to text in the actual request, so a rebuilt step shows the original attachment blocks.
- Character counts are estimates; for exact token counts, trust the usage reported by the provider.

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · Development：```bash
npm test   # self-contained; needs no Harness install and never writes to ~/.dsh
```

- `lib/index.js` — host half (zero npm dependencies, Node built-ins only)
- `lib/client.js` — frontend, hand-written in Harness's `ModuleLoader` format; no build step
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch that inserts the `ctx-visualizer` row
dsh-ctx-visualizer README · License：[MIT](LICENSE)

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · dsh-ctx-visualizer：[English](README.md) | 简体中文

> 看清 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 每一次调用模型时，上下文里到底组装了什么 —— system 与 user 内容、工具 schema、解析出的工具调用、工具执行结果，以及之后的再次调用，以轮次时间线和动态架构图呈现。

这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件（`dsh-plugin`），不是官方包。适合想研究 Agent 循环细节的人：
一次「调模型 → 解析工具调用 → 执行工具 → 结果回填 → 再调模型」的多轮交互里，每一步发给模型的
内容是什么、比上一步多了什么、哪一块在膨胀。

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · 功能：- **左侧 · 轮次**：每轮一张卡片（用户问题、调用次数、工具执行次数、上下文 token、耗时、常用工具），固定窗口可滚动查看较早轮次。
- **顶部 · 横向时间线**：选中轮次内的所有步骤 `第 1 步 · 调模型 → 执行 bash / 结果回填 → 第 2 步 …`，点任意节点切换。
- **右侧 · 明细**（按选中的一步）：
  - **架构**（默认）：根据实际内容动态生成 —— System 按标题自动拆章节、Tools 按来源（MCP server / 内置）分组、对话历史按用户输入分段画成「用户 → 模型调用 → 工具结果」链条，本步新增高亮，压缩摘要单独标出；右侧是本步流转：请求 → 模型 → 每个工具调用的成败/耗时/结果大小 → 回填下一步。
  - **请求上下文**：默认只看「本步新增」的消息；System / 工具清单未变时自动折叠；上下文构成堆叠条（System / 用户输入 / 工具结果 / 插件注入 / Assistant 历史 / 工具 schema）；输入/输出 token 与缓存命中率。
  - **模型响应**、**工具执行**。
  - **原始 JSON**：完整记录，以及 System content / User content（用户输入、工具结果、注入）/ 模型返回等子模块，全部默认折叠，可单独复制。
- **持久化**：实时捕获写入 `~/.dsh/ctx-visualizer/captures/`，插件重载或 Harness 重启后自动恢复。
- **补录历史**：插件启用之前的步骤，按会话日志重放上下文变化还原（包括上下文压缩），标「重建」。
- **脱敏**：入库前掩去 `Bearer …`、`sk-…`、`tos_…`、`ghp_…`、`xoxb-…` 形态的密钥。
- **语言**：自动跟随 Harness 的语言设置（中文 / English），工具栏里有手动切换；手动选择会被记住。

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · 兼容性：| 项目 | 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| 开发与验证环境 | DeepSeek Harness Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` `0.2.2-rc.1`（Web GUI） |
| Node.js（运行测试） | ≥ 20 |

DeepSeek Harness 仍处于 Developer Preview，插件依赖的事件与接口可能发生不兼容变更。遇到问题请先确认版本，并[提 issue](https://github.com/cenbonew/dsh-ctx-visualizer/issues)。

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · 安装：插件没有任何 npm 依赖，克隆下来即可安装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/cenbonew/dsh-ctx-visualizer.git
```

然后在 DeepSeek Harness 里安装这个本地 bundle，任选一种方式：

- **让 Agent 安装**：在对话里说「用 Plugin Manager 安装本地 bundle `/绝对路径/dsh-ctx-visualizer`」。
- **设置页**：设置 › 插件（如果你的版本支持从本地路径安装 bundle）。

`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 让它可以作为 bundle 安装；前端部分由 `dsh.client` 声明，安装后自动接入 Web GUI。

安装后**刷新页面**，在任意会话顶部切到「上下文透视」。插件启用之后的模型调用会被实时捕获，之前的步骤会自动从会话日志补录。

更新：`git pull` 后在 Plugin Manager 里把 bundle 关闭再打开（或重启 Harness），再刷新页面。

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · 原理：只读观察，挂在 Harness 的一等事件上，不修改 Agent 循环：

| 事件 / 服务 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `llm/stream`（waterfall） | 拿到每次模型请求完整的 `GenerateOptions`（`messages`、`tools`、model 等），并在原样透传响应流的同时收集文本、推理、工具调用、usage |
| `agent/request` | 关联轮次 / 步骤编号 |
| `tools/execute`、`tools/result` | 工具执行的入参、结果、耗时、成败，按 `callId` 关联回所在步骤 |
| `agent/error` | 记录失败步骤 |
| `sessionQuery.readSession` | 补录：重放 `system/message`、`user/message`、`assistant/message`、`tool/result` 的 `surfaceOp`（append / 按 seq 区间 replace），还原每次调用前的上下文 |

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · 原理：前端是一个 `conversation.view` 槽位插件，通过 typert Remote 读取宿主侧的 `ctxVisualizer` 服务。
另提供 Inspect Provider `CtxVisualizer`，Agent 可以用 `cordis_inspect_query` 查询捕获概况。

所有监听器都包在 try/catch 里，捕获出错不会影响 Agent 本身。
dsh-ctx-visualizer README · 配置：暂无配置表单。可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中给 `ctx-visualizer` 这一行传配置，或直接修改 `lib/index.js` 顶部的 `DEFAULTS`：

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · 配置：| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `capture` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `persist` | `true` | 是否写盘 |
| `persistDir` | `~/.dsh/ctx-visualizer/captures` | 持久化目录（0700，文件 0600） |
| `backfill` | `true` | 是否从会话日志补录 |
| `backfillIntervalMs` | `30000` | 同一会话两次补录的最小间隔 |
| `maxStepsPerSession` | `80` | 每会话保留的实时步数（补录步骤不计） |
| `maxSessions` | `40` | 保留的会话数 |
| `maxCharsPerText` / `maxCharsPerToolResult` | `400000` / `120000` | 单段文本入库截断上限 |
| `redactSecrets` | `true` | 入库前脱敏 |

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · 隐私与安全：- 捕获内容是**完整的模型上下文**，可能包含代码、文件内容和工具返回的业务数据。数据只保存在本机，不会上传。
- 默认脱敏只识别常见前缀的密钥，**不能保证**掩去所有敏感信息。分享截图或复制 JSON 前请自行检查。
- 模型回复和推理文本暂未脱敏。
- 工具栏「清空捕获」会同时删除磁盘文件。

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · 局限：- 标题生成、上下文压缩等辅助调用不写入会话日志，无法补录（实时捕获时可勾选「显示辅助调用」查看）。
- 文件附件在实际请求中会被投影成文本，补录时显示的是原始附件块。
- 字符数是估算，准确的 token 以 provider 返回的 usage 为准。

dsh-ctx-visualizer README · 开发：```bash
npm test   # 自包含测试，不需要安装 Harness，不会写 ~/.dsh
```

- `lib/index.js`：宿主侧（零 npm 依赖，只用 Node 内置模块）
- `lib/client.js`：前端，直接以 Harness 的 `ModuleLoader` 格式手写，无需构建
- `cordis.patch.yml`：bundle patch，插入一行 `ctx-visualizer`
